method: Owned isolated native Chromium; actual Jezero UI followed by isolated renderer fixture built from exact current mission.js functions and imported current physics-evidence.mjs

normalActualDestinationUI.text:
ENERGÍA
Gastando 40 W
Es de noche en el sitio: consume más de lo que recibe. Batería 100 %.
THERMAL INPUTS / MODEL
Earth nominal · Target critical
Earth: nominal (28.9 K model margin). Target: critical (-9.3 K model margin). At least one input is outside the illustrative operating range; review that input and the thermal assumptions. Earth air and target surface inputs are different source domains; this is not measured rover hardware temperature.
REGIONAL TILT / DEM MODEL
Low regional tilt (1.4°)
Maximum absolute DEM/model pitch or roll; illustrative bands at 6° and 12°. Regional DEM/model tilt does not resolve wheel-scale obstacles, traction or centre-of-mass stability. This is not a local stability certification.
